stories.title: BJJ world champ and AOJ kids coach arrested for sex crimes with underage student

stories.title: Seven wins later, ex-UFC prospect Nick Maximov still waiting for call back — ‘What do I gotta do?’
stories.summary: Former prospect Nick Maximov was not technically released by Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) in 2022. The promotion simply allowed his contract to expire and decided against offering him another one.
